text: As of 29 October 2020, Ak Bars Bank's own register of shareholders listed the State Housing Foundation under the President of the Republic of Tatarstan with 20.41%, the Republic of Tatarstan (through its Ministry of Land and Property Relations) with 19.79%, Svyazinvestneftekhim with 13.61% and Tatneft with 10.41%. The bank's Cbonds profile carries the same four largest stakes without a date.
short: Tatarstan state bodies and companies are Ak Bars Bank's largest shareholders, above 50% combined.

source.note: The bank's own register page, archived by the Wayback Machine because akbars.ru blocks scripted access from datacenter IPs. The register continues: Republic of Tatarstan (via its Ministry of Land and Property Relations) 19.789%, Svyazinvestneftekhim 13.610%, Tatneft 10.413%.

additionalSources.name: Cbonds: Ак Барс Банк company profile
additionalSources.quote: Крупнейшими акционерами банка, с долей более 10% капитала, являются: Государственный жилищный фонд при Президенте РТ – 20.41%, Республика Татарстан – 19.79%, АО Связьинвестнефтехим – 13.61%, ПАО Татнефть – 10.41%
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'The bank's largest shareholders, holding more than 10% of capital, are: the State Housing Fund under the President of the Republic of Tatarstan – 20.41%, the Republic of Tatarstan – 19.79%, AO Svyazinvestneftekhim – 13.61%, PAO Tatneft – 10.41%.' Vintage caution: Cbonds' profile gives no date; its figures exactly match the bank's own October 2020 register. Later registers could not be opened from this environment (akbars.ru times out, e-disclosure.ru returns 403), and the bank's 2025 published IFRS statements redact shareholder detail as 'sensitive information'.
